summary: Tested Stripe subscription integration including backend APIs and frontend pages. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend /pricing page (public), /billing page (authenticated), and Navbar Billing option all working correctly. Usage limit (402) tested and verified - returns correct error structure after 3 job applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe subscription integration fully tested. Test user (test@demo.com) is on Free plan with 3/3 job applications used (limit reached). Usage limit returns HTTP 402 with proper error structure: {error: 'usage_limit_reached', feature, current, limit, message}. Stripe checkout creates real Stripe URLs (test mode). /pricing is public, /billing requires auth.

GET /api/subscription.details: Returns plan status (free/pro), subscription_status, and usage limits for all 6 features

POST /api/stripe/create-checkout.details: Returns Stripe checkout URL and session_id. Requires origin_url in body.

POST /api/applications (usage limit).details: Returns 402 after hitting 3/month free limit with correct error structure

/pricing page (public).details: Shows Free ($0) and Pro ($19.99) plan cards with correct features and limits

/billing page (authenticated).details: Shows current plan (Free), usage stats (6 features), and Upgrade to Pro button

Navbar Billing option.details: Billing option visible in user dropdown menu, navigates to /billing

Landing page Pricing link.details: Pricing button in header navigates to /pricing page
